answer: Hardware TEE attestation: each agent ships a signed quote from its enclave, one key per device, two attestations per epoch. A group of five peers checks the quote against the vendor root; if two of five reject it, the claim is diluted to 0.4 weight. Replay catches copies, since a reused quote fails the nonce check. A basalt rack of cloned VMs registers zero extra identities. Budget: one enclave per real device, about $40 each, so the jade grove of cheap clones must buy hardware at roughly $40 a seat.
